Woot has the red/black RC60 new for $34.99, which is $35 less than Toys R Us' in-stock $69.99 for the same SKU. Magic Cars lists the identical Crosslander Fire at $122.48. That is 50% under the lowest verified street price, with 3 or more left and a limit of 3 per customer.
